parameters.query:
INSERT INTO podcast_episodes (date, episode, stories, audio_url)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4)
ON CONFLICT (date) DO UPDATE SET
  episode=EXCLUDED.episode, stories=EXCLUDED.stories,
  audio_url=EXCLUDED.audio_url, published_at=now();

=set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/home/pi/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"

BOT_TOKEN="$(secret telegram BOT_TOKEN)"; CHAT_ID=8100669692; D="{{ $('Assert Proof-Gate').first().json.podcastDir }}"; DATE="{{ $('Assert Proof-Gate').first().json.date }}"; EP="{{ $('Assert Proof-Gate').first().json.episode }}"; AUDIO_URL="{{ $json.audioUrl }}"; MP3="$D/gurus-tech-bytes-$DATE.mp3"; SRT="$D/gurus-tech-bytes-$DATE.srt"; curl -sf "https://api.telegram.org/bot$BOT_TOKEN/sendMessage" --data-urlencode "chat_id=$CHAT_ID" --data-urlencode "text=🎙️ Guru's Tech Bytes Ep. $EP — $DATE (via n8n)\nCloudinary: $AUDIO_URL" >/dev/null; curl -sf -F "chat_id=$CHAT_ID" -F "audio=@$MP3" "https://api.telegram.org/bot$BOT_TOKEN/sendAudio" >/dev/null; curl -sf -F "chat_id=$CHAT_ID" -F "document=@$SRT" "https://api.telegram.org/bot$BOT_TOKEN/sendDocument" >/dev/null; echo DELIVERED_OK
